parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The list of resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   Job
*   Executor

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to add to the replication pair-consistent group. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. The tag key cannot start with acs: or aliyun.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag. You can specify empty strings as tag values. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://.
